Summary

Enterprise Learning & Training, Leadership Development, Quality & Capability Transformation executive with 18+ years of experience leading enterprise capability strategies, quality governance, business transformation, operational excellence, and performance improvement across global business operations. Proven expertise in aligning organizational capability with business strategy, developing leadership capability, driving change management, strengthening governance, and delivering measurable improvements in workforce readiness, customer experience, operational performance, and commercial outcomes. Experienced in operating model design, commercial enablement, strategic pricing and RFP solutioning, contributing to the growth of large-scale managed service portfolios. I bridge business strategy with workforce capability by integrating learning, quality, governance, analytics and operational excellence to deliver measurable business outcomes and maximize Return on Investment �ROI�.

Executive Leadership Highlights

18+ years leading Enterprise Learning & Training , Leadership Development, Quality, Capability Transformation and Business Transformation across global business operations. Led a multidisciplinary team of approximately 90 Learning, Quality and Capability professionals supporting a workforce of 400+ employees across Europe, EMEA and APAC. Partnered with Senior Directors, Vice Presidents and Client Senior Vice Presidents to align enterprise capability, governance and transformation initiatives with strategic business objectives. Established Training & Quality Centres of Excellence, strengthening leadership capability, knowledge management, governance and organizational performance. Accelerated workforce readiness by 85% through AI-enabled learning transformation, structured capability development and standardized onboarding frameworks. Improved workforce utilization by 25% through enterprise capability development, cross-skilling and performance enablement initiatives. Enabled executive decision-making through business analytics, governance reporting, KPI frameworks and performance insights. Supported commercial growth through operating model design, strategic pricing, commercial enablement and RFP solutioning, contributing to the growth of a ₹100 Cr service portfolio.

Business Impacts

Accelerated workforce readiness by 85%, reducing time-to-productivity through AI-enabled learning transformation and structured capability development. Improved workforce utilization by 25% by implementing cross-skilling, leadership development and capability enhancement initiatives. Established enterprise Training & Quality Centres of Excellence, strengthening governance, standardization, knowledge management and organizational capability. Enabled data-driven executive decision-making through business analytics, KPI frameworks, performance dashboards and governance reporting. Strengthened operational excellence by integrating learning, quality and governance into scalable operating models across global business functions. Supported commercial growth through strategic pricing, RFP solutioning and commercial enablement, contributing to the expansion of a ₹100 Cr managed services portfolio. Built sustainable leadership capability by designing competency frameworks, succession pipelines and leadership development programmes aligned with business strategy. Maximized Return on Investment �ROI� by aligning workforce capability initiatives with measurable business outcomes, operational performance and long-term organizational growth.

Core Competencies

Enterprise Learning & Training Strategy | Quality Governance | Capability Transformation | Leadership Development | Knowledge Management | Performance Enablement | Learning Analytics | Operational Excellence | Change Management | Executive Stakeholder Management | AI-enabled Learning | Lean Six Sigma | Value Realization & ROI Optimization

Work Experience

Senior Manager – Enterprise Learning & Training, Quality & Performance Transformation

Jul 2016-Apr 2026

Tata Consultancy Services

Led an enterprise Learning & Training, Quality & Performance Transformation function supporting a workforce of 400+ employees across Europe, EMEA and APAC, partnering with Senior Directors and Vice Presidents to drive capability transformation, governance and operational excellence. Designed and scaled enterprise Learning & Quality frameworks supporting multiple global service engagements by integrating onboarding, quality governance, knowledge management and performance analytics. Developed enterprise learning and capability strategies aligned with business transformation objectives, strengthening leadership capability, operational excellence and workforce readiness across global operations. Accelerated workforce readiness by 85% by building capability development strategies that combined standardized onboarding, structured learning journeys and AI-enabled learning automation. Improved workforce utilization by 25% through targeted capability interventions, cross-skilling initiatives and data- driven performance improvement programmes that enhanced operational performance and customer experience. Designed leadership development frameworks and coaching models that strengthened managerial capability, improved team effectiveness and supported succession readiness across leadership pipelines. Established enterprise governance frameworks for quality assurance, calibration, SLA compliance and performance reviews, improving operational consistency across multi-region delivery teams. Led enterprise knowledge management initiatives covering content strategy, governance, continuous improvement and training effectiveness measurement to strengthen organizational capability. Partnered with Senior Directors, Vice Presidents and business leaders to align training, quality and capability priorities with strategic initiatives and organizational transformation goals. Enabled executive decision-making through business analytics, KPI dashboards and performance insights that proactively identified capability gaps, quality risks and operational improvement opportunities. Supported commercial growth through strategic pricing analysis, commercial rate revisions and RFP solutioning by providing operational insights, cost-to-serve analysis and scalable operating model recommendations. Led Lean Six Sigma transformation initiatives delivering measurable improvements in quality, operational efficiency, cost optimization and organizational capability.

Manager – Learning & Training, Quality & Centre of Excellence

Apr 2012-Jul 2016

Tata Consultancy Services

Established and scaled an Enterprise Learning & Capability Centre of Excellence �CoE�, leading a team of 15 Learning & Quality professionals supporting 40+ delivery teams across 6 business units, enabling capability development for over 10,000 employees serving 20+ global clients in 60+ countries. Designed enterprise capability frameworks covering onboarding, curriculum architecture, knowledge management and continuous learning, accelerating workforce readiness and improving service quality. Developed governance frameworks, including SOPs, quality scorecards, executive dashboards and performance standards that improved process consistency and operational governance. Introduced analytics-driven quality governance, leveraging operational metrics and root cause analysis to improve customer satisfaction, reduce service defects and enable proactive performance management. Partnered with business, transition and client leadership teams to identify capability gaps, embed governance controls and improve workforce productivity across new and existing business engagements. Led Lean Six Sigma transformation initiatives, reducing operational costs by 15% while improving delivery efficiency by 25% through process optimization and continuous improvement. Received the Best Portfolio Management Award �2016) in recognition of excellence in enterprise capability governance, portfolio management and operational performance.

Team Manager - Operations

Jan 2009-Apr 2012

Tata Consultancy Services

Led multidisciplinary operations teams, embedding structured performance management, quality governance, and workflow optimization practices. Introduced coaching and performance review mechanisms that strengthened capability development and improved operational effectiveness. Partnered with business stakeholders to enhance reporting, governance visibility, and continuous improvement across customer operations.
